scripts.dev: pnpm dev:infra && pnpm --filter @shipgate/server... build && pnpm --filter @shipgate/server database:migrate && pnpm dev:apps
scripts.dev:apps: concurrently --kill-others --names packages,api,worker,web "pnpm --filter './packages/**' --parallel dev" "pnpm --filter @shipgate/server dev:api" "pnpm --filter @shipgate/server dev:worker" "pnpm --filter @shipgate/web dev --host"
scripts.build:production: pnpm --filter @shipgate/server... build && pnpm api:generate:compiled && pnpm --filter @shipgate/web build
scripts.api:generate: pnpm --filter @shipgate/server openapi:generate && pnpm --filter @shipgate/web api:generate && biome format --write apps/web/openapi apps/web/src/api/generated
scripts.api:generate:compiled: pnpm --filter @shipgate/server openapi:generate:compiled && pnpm --filter @shipgate/web api:generate && biome format --write apps/web/openapi apps/web/src/api/generated
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm build:production && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm api:check && pnpm routes:check
